description: This file is a shell script used to manage the WAN interface with DHCP. It handles bringing the WAN up or down based on system events and configurations, manages IP forwarding, firewall restarts, and syncs system states related to the WAN connection.

methods.name: bring_wan_down
methods.description: Function to bring down the WAN interface by disabling IP forwarding, resetting IP and subnet, restarting firewall, and updating system states.

methods.name: bring_wan_up
methods.description: Function to bring up the WAN interface by setting interface name, IP, subnet, restarting necessary services, enabling IP forwarding, and updating system states.
